items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He had Bingham Madison, this arranger... [INTERVIEWEE] He had four arrangers in the band.

ctx.x: He had Bingham Madison, this arranger, Louis Russell, and George Washington.

He had four arrangers in the band. Plus this cat used to arrange for us. He was very good. He was very good. With which band? The Louis Russell's band. He had Bingham Madison, this arranger, Louis Russell, and George Washington. There was four arrangers in the band. Plus this cat used to arrange for us. He knew the style of the band.
